ActionGroup.use: Lay actions out with Stack: <Stack direction="row" wrap align="center" gap={4}> for a row, with justify="end" for the end of a form, and <Stack gap={2}> with fullWidth on each labelled Button for a stacked group. v1-structure rewrites each use.

ActionGroupProps.use: StackProps, with direction, wrap, align, justify and gap.

StackElement.use: Stack, Surface and Text render another element through render, such as render={<section />}; they no longer take as.
